title: Cell-Based Architecture
subtitle: Split users across self-contained copies of the service so one bad deploy reaches only a slice of them
motto: Make the blast radius a design choice
coreAddition: cells behind a router with staged rollout
keyInsight: Cells cut the share of users a failure can reach from all of them to one cell's share, but only if deploys go one cell at a time, and the isolation costs extra infrastructure and a slower rollout.

decisions.title: Show cells failing to help
decisions.description: The failure frame deploys to every cell at once, because isolation that a rollout policy bypasses is a cost with no benefit.
decisions.alternatives: Presenting cells as automatically safe would leave out that the deploy process has to respect them.

decisions.title: Put the cost and the rollout time in the metrics
decisions.description: Every frame reports an infrastructure cost index and the minutes a rollout takes, so the safety is priced in money and in speed.
decisions.alternatives: Reporting only the blast radius would make more cells always look better.
